w: Pontine hemorrhage causes coma, pinpoint pupils and quadriparesis.
Thalamic hemorrhage causes contralateral sensory loss and gaze problems, without cerebellar signs.
p: Cerebellar hemorrhage presents with headache, vomiting, truncal ataxia and nystagmus; large clots with brainstem compression need surgery.

w: Acyclovir treats herpes, which causes painful vesicles.
Azithromycin plus ceftriaxone treats gonorrhea and chlamydia.
p: Latent syphilis is treated with benzathine penicillin G (1 dose if early latent, 3 weekly doses if late or unknown duration).

bw: Young woman, leg weakness and urinary retention
w: Interferon beta reduces relapses over time but does not treat an acute attack.
Plasmapheresis is for steroid-refractory demyelinating attacks.
p: Acute multiple sclerosis relapses (optic neuritis, myelitis) are treated with high-dose IV glucocorticoids for 3-5 days.

w: Montelukast has no role in acute COPD exacerbations.
Theophylline is not recommended because of toxicity and limited benefit.
p: COPD exacerbation: bronchodilators, a short course of systemic steroids, oxygen titrated to 88-92%, and antibiotics if purulent sputum or severe.

w: Endocarditis would cause fever and embolic phenomena.
Pulmonary embolism presents with sudden dyspnea and pleuritic pain, not a new diastolic murmur.
p: Bioprosthetic valves degrade over 10-15 years and need replacement; mechanical valves last longer but require lifelong warfarin.

bw: Obese, medial knee pain below the joint line
Tender medial proximal tibia, negative McMurray
w: Prepatellar bursitis is swelling over the kneecap after kneeling.
A medial meniscus tear gives joint-line tenderness, locking and a positive McMurray test.
p: Pes anserine bursitis causes medial knee pain 2-3 cm below the joint line, common in obese women and diabetics.

bw: Seizure, multiple small ring-enhancing brain lesions
w: Undercooked fish transmits Diphyllobothrium and Anisakis, not brain cysticerci.
Eggs from cat feces transmit Toxoplasma, which gives a few large ring-enhancing lesions in AIDS.
p: Neurocysticercosis: Taenia solium eggs ingested from human feces (fecal-oral) hatch and encyst in the brain; treat with albendazole and steroids.

bw: Severe asthma attack on controller therapy
w: IV corticosteroids help but come after immediate bronchodilation.
Theophylline is not recommended for acute asthma because of toxicity.
p: Acute severe asthma: oxygen, repeated inhaled SABA first, plus ipratropium and systemic steroids; magnesium for refractory cases.

bw: Lithium user: confusion, coarse tremor, dysarthria
w: Bowel irrigation is for sustained-release ingestions, not chronic toxicity with neurologic signs.
Dantrolene treats malignant hyperthermia and is not used in lithium toxicity.
p: Lithium toxicity with neurologic findings or renal failure needs hemodialysis; activated charcoal does not bind lithium.
